lead: Assigning to the binding a `!= null` test narrowed drops the narrowing on that statement's own right-hand side
body: , so the walk `while ($cursor != null) { … $cursor = $cursor->previous; }` is `E0459` on the assignment while every other read in the body is fine. The narrowing holds for the body but not across the write that re-widens the binding. Spell the step `$cursor = $cursor?->previous;` — `?->` answers `null` and the loop's own condition is what ends it.
